mapper.select: select coalesce(max(source_id),0) from integration_schema.cost_center where source_system='SAP'
select * from integration_schema.cost_center where jsonb_build_array(controlling_area,cost_center_code) in cast(#{key} as jsonb) for update
select * from integration_schema.cost_center where source_system='SAP' and source_id in #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into integration_schema.cost_center as target (source_system,source_id,controlling_area,cost_center_code,company_code,name,valid_from,valid_to,blocked,enabled,is_deleted,source_updated_at,payload_hash) values (#{row.sourceSystem},#{row.sourceId},#{row.controllingArea},#{row.costCenterCode},#{row.companyCode},#{row.name},#{row.validFrom},#{row.validTo},#{row.blocked},#{row.enabled},#{row.isDeleted},#{row.sourceUpdatedAt},#{row.payloadHash}) on conflict(source_system,source_id) do update set company_code=excluded.company_code, name=excluded.name, valid_from=excluded.valid_from, valid_to=excluded.valid_to, blocked=excluded.blocked, enabled=excluded.enabled, is_deleted=excluded.is_deleted, source_updated_at=excluded.source_updated_at, payload_hash=excluded.payload_hash,synced_at=clock_timestamp() where target.source_updated_at <=< excluded.source_updated_at
mapper.select: select count(*) from integration_schema.cost_center where (name ilike #{search} or cost_center_code ilike #{search})
select * from integration_schema.cost_center where (name ilike #{search} or cost_center_code ilike #{search}) order by id limit #{size} offset #{offset}
